title: Quietly Rich Mediterranean Chicken Tagine
description: A buttery and velvety one-pot Mediterranean dish featuring gorgonzola-dolce and tandoor spices, made with low-glycemic ingredients for a healthier option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the tandoor spice mix, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the diced tomatoes, chicken broth, and crumbled gorgonzola-dolce cheese to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 25-30 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve the tagine hot over low-glycemic grains or vegetables.
Garnish with additional parsley and gorgonzola-dolce cheese, if desired.
